Post 1
ASX closed at 8,408 pts last week — bulls need a clean break higher, but global rate uncertainty keeps the ceiling low. Mixed stance: domestic resilience vs offshore drag. The tension this week is whether that holds. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 2
🏦 Banks face margin pressure scrutiny as RBA rate cut odds shift. ⛏️ Miners watch China's stimulus pulse — iron ore holding near $100/t is the line in the sand. Two sectors, two very different catalysts. #banking #ironore #ASX

Post 3
🔺 BHP in focus — iron ore near $100/t means every dollar move hits earnings hard. China's property data this week could reprice the stock fast. Watch the open Monday closely. #mining #BHP #ausbiz

Post 4
S&P 500 closed near 5,860 pts. US earnings season is mid-stride — any guidance cuts from industrials or tech will ripple into ASX sentiment Monday morning. Offshore lead matters more than usual right now. #ASX #ausbiz #globalmarkets

Post 5
China's Q3 GDP drops this week — market pricing modest 4.7% growth. A miss tightens the squeeze on miners and energy names. A beat lifts the whole resources complex. Which way are you positioned? #China #ASX #commodities

Post 1
📈 Two stocks up 20% in a single session — and the index barely blinked. ASX 200 added 39.00pts or 0.44% to 8,845.70, a 20-day high, while sitting 4.85% off its 52-week peak. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 2
🔋 Energy led Monday at +2.21%, coal names driving the charge. Tech was the drag, falling 1.31%. Financials added 0.86%. The rotation out of growth into value is doing the heavy lifting. #ASX #energy #ausbiz

Post 3
CGF surged 19.29% to AUD 11.75 — Challenger's single-day move is the kind of re-rating that resets analyst price targets. CWY wasn't far behind at +20.24%. Two outliers, one session. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 4
🪙 Gold sits at AUD 6,014.15/oz with the AUD/USD at 0.6978. Silver at AUD 82.81/oz. Metals holding firm as the local dollar stays under pressure — a tailwind for unhedged producers. #gold #silver #ASX #metals

Post 5
ASX 200 is 4.85% from its 52-week high. The question is whether energy and financials can sustain Monday's momentum. Watch coal prices and US tech overnight — does the IT sector -1.31% gap close or widen? #ASX #ausbiz
